state: CanMaintain must allow a scoped manager to revise an inspection plan or retire an asset even when it has 99, 100, 101 or 1000 independent plans/instances. Current synchronous CRUD hooks iterate future pending inspections with limit=100, and retirement also iterates plans with limit=100. Limits reject the entire mutation. The Plan invariant additionally depends on current technician role/employment and nonretirement, so leaving plans configured active during deferred retirement cleanup currently fails the invariant. Freeze checklist, inspector, due occurrence and completed results; preserve inspections already due/overdue at the change, while canceling superseded future pending work with original actor/time attribution. Current role/location authorization belongs at creation, generation, reminder dispatch and use; revocation must not invalidate historical records. A later template edit or asset reinstatement must not resurrect work the earlier change invalidated, even if cleanup is delayed or replayed. Atomic mutation size must be independent of the number of unrelated records; finite per-inspection checks still retain bounds. Existing primitives are contained records, pure derives/guards, immutable child evidence, CRUD hooks, committed identity events, keyed schedules, one-record ID continuations and authorized user recovery. Generic audit/queue replay is not a new app API for historic guard reads. CanRent alone owns downtime/affected-booking/release. Do not add a scheduler, cross-owner transaction or copied booking ledger. The implementation is a draft source/desired target, not an existing parser/runtime constraint.

progress.instructions: Choose the smallest maintainable option that satisfies every stated authority, evidence, larger-volume and delayed-work outcome. Compare the same facts fairly, including costs; flag uncertainty or missing assumptions.

criteria.atomic_caps: Retain current synchronous cancellation/deactivation loops and the dynamic Plan invariant; refuse any over-limit edit/retirement and require the manager to reduce scope beforehand. Simple immediate atomic cleanup and no extra evidence model, but it cannot satisfy normal 101/1000-record progress or invariant independence from later authority changes.
criteria.event_only: Use constant-sized hooks and move authority checks to admission/dispatch. Emit typed cutoff/revision/retirement-generation/actor/time events and walk one record per continuation, without any retained cancellation-boundary record. Small schema, but current use must rely on the latest mutable plan/asset facts; later changes can forget an earlier cancellation cutoff, and a user has no canonical retained intent to inspect/restart lost backlog unless another historic interface is invented.
criteria.owned_evidence: Use constant-sized authorized hooks to retain one immutable owner-local cancellation boundary: its plan-before revision or asset-before retirement generation, due-date cutoff, reason and actor/time. Capture asset generation in Inspection and increment it on retirement so reinstatement produces distinguishable fresh work. A persisted cursor/status and declared continuation cancel only matching still-pending future instances; inspect/work admission consults retained boundaries immediately, including completed cleanup evidence. A scoped retry addresses this business record. Costs are a small contained evidence model, generation field and guard/query; benefits are attributable visible progress and safe replay/later-edit/reinstatement while retaining frozen old/current evidence and independent Rent ownership.
